reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004AD1B0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AD1B0-Camera_UpdateTransform_27.cpp at sha256 81a0fe17b8587ec49d9451642afb3a46b9757e7a3e79b3c0e220d45029b86316 (recorded implementation.signature: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure Camera_UpdateTransform_27(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_UpdateTransform_27
retail_function.signature: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure
retail_function.summary: 11 blocks / 16 edges: same normalisation as 0x4AD140 but computes the remainder: if arg4!=0 divide, multiply the quotient by arg3, subtract from the dividend with the borrow corrections (`sub eax,arg3` on both paths), and return -(remainder - arg1) in EDX:EAX; the arg4==0 path returns ((arg2%arg3)<<32 | arg1) % arg3. Called from 0x004A7CD2 in _output.

candidate_function.signature: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure Camera_UpdateTransform_27(void);
candidate_function.summary: __aullrem(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) lifts the BN pseudo for both paths including the two borrow corrections, but declares `unsigned int` and loses the high half.

divergences: Return width: retail returns EDX:EAX (the value is the remainder of a 64-bit divide); the candidate returns 32 bits and drops the high half.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure" at 0x004AD1B0; radare2 recovers "fcn.004ad1b0 (int32_t arg_8h, int32_t arg_ch, int32_t arg_10h, int32_t arg_14h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004AD1B0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure Camera_UpdateTransform_27(void);.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate defines __aullrem, not the catalog name Camera_UpdateTransform_27.
The retail identity is the MSVC 64-bit unsigned remainder helper; the catalog name is a harvest label.
